title: At the Planck scale, non-computable mathematics has no room

statements.text: In a quantum computer on a non-commutative background, the model of quantum gravity, all computable functions are the laws of physics in their primordial form and non-computable mathematics finds no room in the physical world.

sources.quote: In this domain, all computable functions are the laws of physics in their most primordial form, and non computable mathematics finds no room in the physical world
